programs.title: Tech Skills Training
programs.description: Industry-aligned curricula in modern web development, machine learning, and data science, built to turn theoretical knowledge into practical capability.

programs.title: Startup Incubation
programs.description: A rigorous 3-6 month program designed to transform minimum viable products into scalable tech enterprises, including mentorship, legal structuring, and seed funding access.

programs.title: Internships & SIWES
programs.description: Structured industrial attachment placements for engineering students, providing hands-on experience in active tech projects and corporate workflows.

projects.title: ParaVision — AI Diagnostic Support System
projects.description: An AI-powered diagnostic support system that helps healthcare professionals detect malaria and intestinal parasites faster and more consistently through intelligent image analysis, reducing laboratory workload and improving access to timely diagnostic support.

projects.title: SmartIrrigate — IoT Soil Sensor Network
projects.description: A LoRaWAN-based soil moisture and micro-climate sensor network built to help smallholder farms schedule irrigation with far less guesswork and water waste.

projects.title: CampusEats — Cafeteria Queue Predictor
projects.description: A statistical model that forecasts cafeteria queue length by time of day using two semesters of historical foot-traffic data collected by student volunteers.

projects.title: LectureLink — Offline-First Notes Sync
projects.description: A lecture-notes app built for low-connectivity campuses: it works fully offline and reconciles changes once a network connection briefly reappears.

projects.title: GridWatch — Power Outage Logger
projects.description: A low-cost ESP32 logger that timestamps grid power outages across hostel blocks, producing reliability reports the estate office actually uses.

projects.title: ArtisanChain — Local Craft Marketplace
projects.description: A directory site connecting student and local artisans with buyers, built as a static-first storefront with a simple order-by-WhatsApp flow.

projects.title: VoltGuard — Surge Protection Trainer Kit
projects.description: A benchtop teaching kit that lets first-year students safely observe and measure voltage surge behaviour before working with live lab equipment.
